newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Fleet lends Columbus McKinnon $325 mln.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Fleet lends Columbus McKinnon $325 mln.

text.p: NEW YORK, Aug 28 (LPC) - Fleet Financial Group Inc has underwritten a $325 million loan for Columbus McKinnon Corp's acquisition of Yale International, banking sources said.
The loan is split between a $125 million revolver and a $125 million amortizing term loan, both maturing in five years, a banker said.
Additionally, a $75 million B term loan will be sold to institutional investors, the banker added.

Pricing on the amortizing term loan and revolver starts at 250 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), with a 50-basis-point annual fee on undrawn amounts, sources said. The B term loan is priced at 300 basis points over LIBOR, sources added.
Syndication of the loan should begin in the next few weeks, bankers said.
Columbus has offered to purchase Yale at $24 per share in a deal to be executed on or before August 30, sources said.
